stops.name: Marismas de Alba
stops.detail: The Natural Park of the Marismas de Alba, the Alba Marsh or the Xunqueira de Alba (in Galician), is a natural park and wetland in the city of Pontevedra in Spain, and one of the few Marshes in the Ria de Pontevedra. It is a park used as a place for walking, cycling and observing the fauna and flora.
